title.narrative: Enhancing Youth Employability and Entrepreneurship in Tanzania

description.narrative: This project is under the scope of the United Nations Joint Programme (UNJP), which has been developed by the UN system in Tanzania upon request of the Government of Tanzania, Ministry of Labor and Employment, to support activities and initiatives aiming at youth employment under the National Youth Employment Creation Programme (NYECP). UNIDO will contribute to Outcome 4 #Increased employability among young women and men in both rural and urban areas# of the UNJP. Precisely, UNIDO intends to contribute to UNJP output 4.1.3, #Linkages created between businesses and universities# and UNJP output 4.1.4, #Strengthen institutional capacities of local BDS supporting youth entrepreneurship initiatives#. Thus, the overall UNIDO objective is twofold, it comprises (i) to increase the employability of young graduates in industry and (ii) to foster youth entrepreneurship as a means of self-employment. The rapid economic growth in Tanzania over the last decade did not translate into the creation of sufficient productive work opportunities, leaving unemployment rates high, especially among young and female people aged 15-24. Youth unemployment (15%) is recognized as a major challenge by the Tanzanian Government.
